name: Forward Email MCP
description: Gives MCP clients 68 tools over the Forward Email API to manage domains, aliases, outbound email, IMAP mailboxes, contacts, and calendars, running locally over stdio.

skills.name: Domain And Alias Management
skills.description: Adds domains, verifies their DNS and SMTP records, and creates, updates, or deletes aliases and their generated passwords with an API key.

skills.name: Mailbox Access
skills.description: Lists, reads, creates, updates, and deletes messages and folders in an alias mailbox over IMAP, using the alias address and a generated password.

skills.name: Contacts And Calendars
skills.description: Manages an alias's CardDAV contacts and CalDAV calendars and events, so an assistant can clean up contacts or schedule meetings.

skills.name: Outbound Email
skills.description: Sends email over Forward Email's outbound SMTP and lists, inspects, or deletes sent messages and checks the account's sending limit.

skills.name: Sieve Filter Scripts
skills.description: Creates, updates, and deletes Sieve filtering scripts at domain scope with an API key, or per alias with that alias's credentials.
